title: Unit 4 第二课时 基础达标与综合拓展

sections.title: I. 根据音标写单词
sections.instruction: 根据音标写出正确的英文单词。

questions.prompt: 1. The Book of Poetry, the earliest collection of poems (诗集), is of great value (价值) in Chinese /'hɪstri/ ______.
questions.translation: 《诗经》是最早的诗歌总集，在中国历史上具有巨大的价值。
questions.explanation: 根据音标 /'hɪstri/ 可知此处应填名词 history（历史）。故填 history。

questions.prompt: 2. My /'feɪvərɪt/ ______ movie is The Battle at Lake Changjin and I want to watch it again.
questions.translation: 我最喜欢的电影是《长津湖》，我还想再看一遍。
questions.explanation: 根据音标 /'feɪvərɪt/ 可知此处应填形容词 favourite（特别喜爱的）。故填 favourite。

questions.prompt: 3. I like books because they offer me a lot of /'ju:sfl/ ______ knowledge.
questions.translation: 我喜欢书，因为它们提供给我很多有用的知识。
questions.explanation: 根据音标 /'ju:sfl/ 可知此处应填形容词 useful（有用的）。故填 useful。

questions.prompt:
4. —Richard, do you like /dʒi'ɒɡrəfi/ ______?
—Yes. I like it best.
questions.translation:
—— 理查德，你喜欢地理吗？
—— 是的，我最喜欢它。
questions.explanation: 根据音标 /dʒi'ɒɡrəfi/ 可知此处应填学科名词 geography（地理）。故填 geography。

questions.prompt: 5. What kind of /'mju:zɪk/ ______ do you like, jazz or rock?
questions.translation: 你喜欢哪种音乐，爵士还是摇滚？
questions.explanation: 根据音标 /'mju:zɪk/ 可知此处应填名词 music（音乐）。故填 music。

sections.title: II. 选择合适的连词填空
sections.instruction: 根据句意，从方框中选择合适的连词填空。

questions.prompt: 1. Smile to the world, ______ the world will smile back to you.
questions.translation: 对世界微笑，世界就会对你微笑。
questions.explanation: “祈使句, and + 简单句”句型，and 表示顺承或递进。故填 and。

questions.prompt:
2. —Are there any bananas at home?
—No, ______ we have some strawberries. Would you like some?
questions.translation:
—— 家里有香蕉吗？
—— 没有，但我们有一些草莓。你想来点吗？
questions.explanation: 前后句之间表示转折关系，用连词 but。故填 but。

questions.prompt: 3. I'm Chinese ______ I don't live in China.
questions.translation: 我是中国人，但我不留在中国生活。
questions.explanation: 我是中国人与我不留在中国生活之间存在转折关系，用 but。故填 but。

questions.prompt: 4. Tony can play basketball ______ his brother can't.
questions.translation: 托尼会打篮球，但是他的弟弟不会。
questions.explanation: 前半句肯定后半句否定，两者呈转折对比关系，用 but。故填 but。

questions.prompt:
5. —Can you play football?
—Yes, ______ I can play table tennis too.
questions.translation:
—— 你会踢足球吗？
—— 是的，而且我还会打乒乓球。
questions.explanation: 表示递进补充并列信息，用 and。故填 and。

questions.prompt: 6. Peter is never late for class, ______ he is given the model pupil award this year.
questions.translation: 彼得上课从不迟到，所以今年他获得了模范学生奖。
questions.explanation: 前句是原因，后句是结果，表示因果关系用连词 so。故填 so。

questions.prompt: 7. One of the car parts isn't working, ______ I am not sure which one.
questions.translation: 汽车的一个零件坏了，但我不确定是哪一个。
questions.explanation: 坏了与不确定是哪一个之间为转折关系，用 but。故填 but。

questions.prompt: 8. Work hard, ______ you can make great progress in your English.
questions.translation: 努力用功，你的英语就能取得巨大的进步。
questions.explanation: “祈使句 + and + 陈述句”，意为“只要……就……”，用 and。故填 and。

questions.prompt: 9. Put on your coat, ______ you'll catch a cold.
questions.translation: 穿上你的外套，否则你会感冒的。
questions.explanation: “祈使句 + or + 陈述句”，or 意为“否则”。故填 or。

questions.prompt: 10. Many students like having iced drinks in summer, ______ it is hot.
questions.translation: 许多学生喜欢在夏天喝冷饮，因为天气很热。
questions.explanation: 后句解释前句喜欢喝冷饮的原因，用连词 because。故填 because。

sections.title: III. 选择合适的疑问词填空
sections.instruction: 根据句意，从方框中选择合适的疑问词填空。

questions.prompt:
1. —______ do you think of the movie Me and My Motherland?
—I love it! It's a great movie.
questions.translation:
—— 你觉得电影《我和我的祖国》怎么样？
—— 我很喜欢它！这是一部很棒的电影。
questions.explanation: 询问对某事物的看法固定句型为 What do you think of...? 句首首字母大写 What。故填 What。

questions.prompt:
2. —______ did you celebrate the Dragon Boat Festival this year, Tom?
—By making rice dumplings with my Chinese friends.
questions.translation:
—— 汤姆，你今年是怎么庆祝端午节的？
—— 通过和我的中国朋友一起包粽子。
questions.explanation: 答语 By doing sth. 表示方式，对方式提问用疑问词 How。故填 How。

questions.prompt:
3. —______ do you put a lot of snakes into the forest?
—To protect the ecosystem.
questions.translation:
—— 你们为什么把许多蛇放进森林里？
—— 为了保护生态系统。
questions.explanation: 答语 To do sth. 表目的，对其提问原因用疑问词 Why。故填 Why。

sections.title: IV. 用所给单词的正确形式填空
sections.instruction: 用所给单词的正确形式填空。
sections.passage:
1. I have four maths classes a week. I like maths. So the maths classes are not [1] (bore) for me.
2. On Sundays, my sister [2] (learn) English with me in the school club. Both of us are interested in English.
3. We teenagers should spend more time [3] (learn) more about the outside world.
4. When I heard the [4] news, I felt [5] (excite).
5. Add all the [6] (number) together.

questions.prompt: 1. (bore)
questions.translation: 所以我觉得数学课并不无聊。
questions.explanation: 主语 the maths classes 指事物，作表语用 -ing 结尾的形容词 boring，意为“令人厌烦的”。故选 boring。

questions.prompt: 2. (learn)
questions.translation: 在周日，我妹妹在学校俱乐部和我一起学英语。
questions.explanation: On Sundays 表示经常性动作，时态为一般现在时；主语 my sister 是第三人称单数，动词用 learns。故选 learns。

questions.prompt: 3. (learn)
questions.translation: 我们青少年应该花更多的时间去了解外面的世界。
questions.explanation: spend time (in) doing sth. 是固定句型，表示“花费时间做某事”，后接动名词 learning。故选 learning。

questions.prompt: 4. (excite - exciting news)
questions.translation: 当我听到这个令人兴奋的消息时……
questions.explanation: 修饰名词 news 用形容词 exciting，表示“令人兴奋的消息”。故选 exciting。

questions.prompt: 5. (excite - felt excited)
questions.translation: 我感到很激动。
questions.explanation: feel 为系动词，主语 I 指人，感到兴奋用形容词 excited。故选 excited。

questions.prompt: 6. (number)
questions.translation: 把所有的数字加在一起。
questions.explanation: all the 后面接可数名词复数 numbers。故选 numbers。

sections.title: V. 完形填空
sections.instruction: 通读下面短文，掌握其大意，然后在各题所给的四个选项中选出一个最佳答案。
sections.passage:
Hi! I'm Cheng Ling. I'm a [1] of Class 3, Grade 7. My school life is very [2]. Classes begin at 8 o'clock. We have four classes in the [3]. In the afternoon, we have two classes. We have English, science, history, music and [4] other subjects. [5] is my favourite subject. I often sing and dance with my classmates on weekends. But I [6] science, because I think it's difficult and [7]. Do you think so?

After school, I often play soccer with [8] friends. Sometimes I swim in a swimming club. But my favourite sport is volleyball. And I can play it [9].

I like my school life very much. [10] you tell me about your school life?

questions.translation: 我是七年级三班的一名学生。
questions.explanation: 根据后文“of Class 3, Grade 7”以及描述学校生活可知程玲是一名“学生（student）”。故选 student。

questions.translation: 我的学校生活非常有趣。
questions.explanation: 根据文末“I like my school life very much.”可知，学校生活很“有趣（interesting）”。故选 interesting。

questions.translation: 我们在上午有四节课。
questions.explanation: 后文说“In the afternoon, we have two classes.”，对应前半句应为“在上午（in the morning）”。故选 morning。

questions.translation: 我们有英语、科学、历史、音乐以及其他一些学科。
questions.explanation: 肯定句中修饰可数名词复数 other subjects 用 some，意为“一些”。故选 some。

questions.translation: 音乐是我最喜欢的学科。
questions.explanation: 由后句“I often sing and dance with my classmates on weekends.”可知最喜欢的学科是音乐（Music）。故选 Music。

questions.translation: 但我不喜欢科学，因为我觉得它很难且无聊。
questions.explanation: 由 But 及“because I think it's difficult...”可知表示否定“不喜欢”，主语 I 为第一人称，助动词用 don't like。故选 don't like。

questions.translation: 因为我觉得它既难又无聊。
questions.explanation: difficult 与 boring 都是负面评价，用 and 连接并列形容词。故选 boring。

questions.translation: 放学后，我经常和我的朋友们一起踢足球。
questions.explanation: 主语为 I，对应的形容词性物主代词用 my（我的）。故选 my。

questions.translation: 并且我排球打得很好。
questions.explanation: 修饰动词 play 用副词 well，意为“好”。故选 well。

questions.translation: 你能告诉我关于你的学校生活吗？
questions.explanation: 向对方提出请求“你能……吗？”，用情态动词 Can 引导一般疑问句。故选 Can。

sections.title: VI. 语篇填空
sections.instruction: 阅读下面短文，在空白处填入1个适当的单词或括号内单词的正确形式。
sections.passage: Hello! My name [1] (be) Jack. I'm [2] Tokyo(东京). I can speak [3] little English, [4] I can't speak Chinese. I usually get up at 6 o'clock and go to school at seven thirty [5] the morning. I think art is [6] (interest). I don't like science. I think it is [7] (bored). I want to [8] (go) to China and Thailand. I think [9] (it) are beautiful countries(国家). I want to make [10] (friend) with you.

questions.translation: 你好！我的名字叫杰克。
questions.explanation: 主语 My name 是单数，一般现在时 be 动词用 is。故选 is。

questions.translation: 我来自东京。
questions.explanation: be from 表示“来自……”，故填介词 from。故选 from。

questions.translation: 我会说一点点英语。
questions.explanation: a little 表示“一点点”，修饰不可数名词 English。故选 a。

questions.translation: 但我不会说中文。
questions.explanation: 前面会说一点英语与后句不会说中文是转折关系，用连词 but。故选 but。

questions.translation: 在早晨七点半去上学。
questions.explanation: “在早晨”固定短语为 in the morning。故选 in。

questions.prompt: 6. (interest)
questions.translation: 我认为美术很有趣。
questions.explanation: 主语 art 指学科，作表语用修饰物的形容词 interesting，意为“有趣的”。故选 interesting。

questions.prompt: 7. (bored)
questions.translation: 我认为它很无聊。
questions.explanation: 主语 it 指代 science（科学课），表示事物令人无聊应用 boring。故选 boring。

questions.translation: 我想去中国和泰国。
questions.explanation: want to do sth. 想要做某事，to 后面接动词原形 go。故选 go。

questions.translation: 我认为它们是美丽的国家。
questions.explanation: 指代上文提到的 China and Thailand 这两个国家，作从句主语且谓语是 are，用主格代词 they。故选 they。

questions.prompt: 10. (friend)
questions.translation: 我想和你们交朋友。
questions.explanation: make friends with sb. 是固定短语，表示“与某人交朋友”，名词用复数 friends。故选 friends。

sections.title: VII. (2025·烟台)阅读理解
sections.instruction: 阅读下列网络论坛贴文，从每题所给的四个选项中选出最佳答案。
sections.passage:
**English Club ESL Forums**

**Do you have any history book recommendations?**  
by **Cayitam** >> April 30th, 2025, 8:47 a.m.  

Hello there, I'm writing to see if anyone happens to have any suggestions for history books. Perhaps you've read some good ones recently. I'm really interested in finding a new history book to read, so I hope someone may have a recommendation. It would be great if you could let me know what you think is worth reading.  

*(Poster: Cayitam | New Poster | Posts: 1)*

---

**Re: Do you have any history book recommendations?**  
by **LinguaSpark** >> May 4th, 2025, 5:25 p.m.  

Hi, Cayitam! I'd recommend *Sapiens: A Brief History of Humankind* by Yuval Noah Harari. It's a fascinating introduction to human history, telling the story of humans from ancient days to today's modern world. The book talks about big turning points in human history. Harari also asks interesting questions, such as whether things like money or nations are just "stories" we all believe in together. It's an easy-to-read book that makes you think differently about history. Happy reading!  

*(Poster: LinguaSpark | New Poster | Posts: 2)*

questions.prompt: 1. What's the purpose of Cayitam's post?
options: To prepare for a history exam.
To buy a history book online.
To show the importance of history.
To find a history book to read.
questions.translation: Cayitam 发帖的目的是什么？—— 寻找一本历史书来读。
questions.explanation: 根据 Cayitam 的发言“I'm really interested in finding a new history book to read, so I hope someone may have a recommendation.”可知其目的是找一本历史书来读。故选 To find a history book to read。

questions.prompt: 2. What do we know about LinguaSpark?
options: He is teaching a history lesson.
He is telling the story of humans.
He is introducing a history book.
questions.translation: 关于 LinguaSpark 我们能了解到什么？—— 他正在介绍一本历史书。
questions.explanation: 根据 LinguaSpark 的回复“I'd recommend Sapiens: A Brief History of Humankind by Yuval Noah Harari. It's a fascinating introduction to human history...”可知他在向大家推荐并介绍一本历史书。故选 He is introducing a history book。

questions.prompt: 3. After reading Sapiens: A Brief History of Humankind, LinguaSpark might ________
options: find the book difficult to understand
dislike the questions in the books
have a new understanding of history
questions.translation: 在阅读了《人类简史》之后，LinguaSpark 可能会：对历史有全新的认识和理解。
questions.explanation: 根据 LinguaSpark 所述“It's an easy-to-read book that makes you think differently about history.”（这是一本通俗易懂的书，它会让你对历史有不同的思考）可知，读者可能会对历史产生新的认识。故选 have a new understanding of history。
